notes: This unit reconciles a DECISION, not a mutation. The legacy deletes; the target computes the same delete set and, by P3-D03, does not act on it until a human sets the enable flag. Source side is the set of objects the legacy actually removed from its isolated per-run clone bucket, derived as (pinned inventory snapshot) minus (clone contents after the legacy run), loaded into ow_tp.bronze.p3_cleanup_legacy_delete_set. Target side is ow_tp.silver.storage_cleanup_candidates, computed from the same immutable snapshot with deletion disabled. The two sides never share mutable state: the legacy mutates a clone, the target only reads the snapshot. The comparison is exact set equality on (key, size) — size is in the key because a key-only match would not catch a truncating copy, and the legacy copies to quarantine before deleting. Set equality is the gate that unlocks the enable flag; anything less than exact leaves deletion off.
